---
name: Rule dispute
about: A rule in this repo is wrong, outdated, or contested
title: "[rule] "
labels: dispute
---

## Which rule

Quote the line and link the file.

## What is wrong with it

Mechanism, measurement, convention, or preference. Say which.

## Counter-evidence

Link a primary source, or two independent credible secondary sources. Anecdotes
are welcome but will be graded V3.

## What should replace it

If you know. If not, say so and the next wave will look.
